comment: Coverage floors for the CI coverage job (regression floors, ~1-1.5 points below measured, not tier targets; raise as coverage climbs). Mirrored into the coverage:check npm script in package.json and guarded by test/unit/coverage_thresholds_sync.test.js. Re-measured 2026-09-23 with c8 --all (every src/**/*.js file counts even if a test never requires it) and the declared siblings checked out: 94.41 lines/statements, 86.29 branches, 92.87 functions over 2348 unit tests.
